description:
Primary Job Duties: 
 Knowledge and experience with agile software development process 
 Full stack engineering experience will be a huge plus 
 Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical knowledge to business needs 
 Exposure and/or experience in one or more technical areas (e.g. programming language, application support) 
 Proficient in object oriented design principles and automated testing strategies for web applications 
 Experiences of code refactoring, design patterns, design driven development, continuous integration, building highly scalable applications, and application security 
 Computer Science four year degree or related degree or equivalent work experience 
 Enjoys complex problem solving and ability to push the innovation on solutions 
 Self-starter with ability to tailor and demonstrates strong ownership 
 Effective communicator with good written and oral communication skills 
 Enthusiastic, high energy, motivated, and driven professional to help your team excel 
 
 Programming Languages: 
 .NET (C#) and design patterns (MVC) 
 Service oriented architecture (webApi) 
 Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Ajax, HTML, CSS and responsive design 
 Strong knowledge of AngularJS 
 Strong knowledge of unit and automation testing frameworks (Moq, nunit) 
 
 Database Skills: 
 Microsoft SQL Server focused 
 Performance tuning of database tables and stored procedures
